question: Which Hydration Sunscreen regions are above forecast, and are the control regions flat?
query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'regions'[regionId],
    'regions'[regionName],
    'regions'[signalAffected],
    TREATAS({"PROD-HS-100"}, 'products'[productId]),
    "Hero Forecast Variance %", [Hero Forecast Variance %],
    "Actual Sales Variance %", [Actual Sales Variance %],
    "Modelled Weather Uplift %", [Modelled Weather Uplift %],
    "Weather Uplift vs Sales Variance Delta %", [Weather Uplift vs Sales Variance Delta %]
)
ORDER BY 'regions'[signalAffected] DESC, [Hero Forecast Variance %] DESC

question: What is the targeted campaign opportunity for Hydration Sunscreen in the signal-affected regions?
query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'campaign_scenarios'[scenarioId],
    'campaign_scenarios'[scenarioName],
    'campaign_scenarios'[recommended],
    'campaign_scenarios'[approved],
    TREATAS({"SCN-2026-HS-B"}, 'campaign_scenarios'[scenarioId]),
    "Opportunity Incremental Units", [Opportunity Incremental Units],
    "Opportunity Incremental Revenue USD", [Opportunity Incremental Revenue USD],
    "Recommended Scenario Budget USD", [Recommended Scenario Budget USD],
    "Recommended Scenario Confidence", [Recommended Scenario Confidence],
    "Commercial Approval Limit USD", [Commercial Approval Limit USD]
)

question: How big is the production capacity shortfall before choosing the recommended plan?
query:
EVALUATE
ROW(
    "Required Incremental Units", [Required Incremental Units],
    "Campaign Capacity Without Maintenance Units", [Campaign Capacity Without Maintenance Units],
    "Maintenance Capacity Lost Units", [Maintenance Capacity Lost Units],
    "Capacity Headroom Units", [Capacity Headroom Units],
    "Capacity Shortfall Units", [Capacity Shortfall Units],
    "Max Deliverable Incremental Units Under Best Plan", [Max Deliverable Incremental Units Under Best Plan],
    "Recommended Option Incremental Units Delivered", [Recommended Option Incremental Units Delivered],
    "Recommended Option Shortfall Units", [Recommended Option Shortfall Units]
)

question: For CASE-2026-HS-001, is the decision still open and are outcomes available?
query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'decision_cases'[caseId],
    'decision_cases'[title],
    'decision_cases'[status],
    'decision_cases'[originSignalId],
    TREATAS({"CASE-2026-HS-001"}, 'decision_cases'[caseId]),
    "Decision Case Count", [Decision Case Count],
    "Outcome Planned Incremental Units", [Outcome Planned Incremental Units],
    "Outcome Delivered Incremental Units", [Outcome Delivered Incremental Units],
    "Outcome Incremental Units Variance", [Outcome Incremental Units Variance],
    "Outcome Stress % at Maintenance", [Outcome Stress % at Maintenance],
    "Outcome Existing Order Fulfilment %", [Outcome Existing Order Fulfilment %]
)
